SIT_COMFORTABLY_MESSAGE: Please sit comfortably with your face around 50cm from your screen during the experiment.
TUTORIAL_INTRODUCTION_MESSAGE:
This experiment will consist of three main parts and lasts approximately 1 hour.
  1. During the first part, you will be familiarizing yourself with a tapping task, central to the experiment. Approximately 10 minutes
  2. During the second part, you will be performing a 'sense of control' experiment that involves repeated tapping trials with short yes/no questions. Approximately 10 minutes
  3. During the third part, you will be performing a task where you can perform tapping trials in exchange for a reward. Approximately 40 minutes


Note that you can best take a break in between these parts or at predefined timeslots during the third part. The program will suggest specific break moments.
You can also come back to the experiment later (but within 24 hours) by reopening the link in the email.

DOMINANT_HAND_MESSAGE:
Select your preferred 'tapping' hand.

During the experiment you will be completing repeated tapping trials that require you to repeatedly tap a key on the keyboard. To ensure you are best able to complete the task, please select your preferred hand to perform the repeated tapping movement. This should be either the hand least affected by the disease or, if there is no difference, your dominant hand.
INSTRUCTION_PAGES: The experiment consists of various series of 'tapping trials'. The following screens will take you step-by-step through a single tapping trial. Throughout the experiment, the keyboard keys involved in a tapping trial stay unchanged.

Step 1:
When prompted, press and hold down the {{HOLD_KEY}} key with your {{HOLD_FINGER}} to start the trial.

Step 2:
Holding down the {{HOLD_KEY}} key will start a countdown. Continue to keep the {{HOLD_KEY}} pressed down during the countdown.

Step 3:
After the countdown, you will see a 'GO' message, at this point, start repeatedly tapping the {{TAP_KEY}} key with your {{TAP_FINGER}}

Always tap with you {{TAP_FINGER}}, never change fingers!

Careful
  • Do not release the {{HOLD_KEY}} key while tapping
  • Do not start tapping the {{TAP_KEY}} key before you see the 'Go Message'.
  • Never change fingers during the experiment

CORE_TAPPING_INSTRUCTIONS_PAGES:
You will now begin the next experiment.

This experiment will be the offer-based Tapping Task. This part consists of {{NUMBER_OF_BLOCKS}} blocks. Each block consists of:

  • {{NUMBER_OF_DEMO_TRIALS}} demo trials, to get used to the tapping "feeling" of that block
  • A number of offers to perform the tapping task (more about the offers in the next pages)
  • A set of questions to answer at the end of each block

At the end of each block you will have an option to take a break.

Demo Trials

Each block will start with {{NUMBER_OF_DEMO_TRIALS}} demo trials. These demo trials will have the same tapping "feeling" as all the tapping trials in the block. This "feeling" differs between blocks.

Tapping Offers:

During the main part of the block, you will be receiving offers to perform the tapping task with varying effort levels (how much you need to tap), reward levels (how much money you receive for tapping), and tapping feeling, which you have familiarized yourself with during the demo trials.

Effort is determined by how high the blue target area is located, the higher the target area the more tapping "effort" you have to do to reach it.

Reward is defined in points, with each point being worth {{POINT_VALUE}}{{CURRENCY}}. Your total of collected points determines the reward you will receive at the end of the experiment.

Based on this information you can decide to accept the offer {{ACCEPT_OFFER_BUTTON}} and try to earn the reward or decline the offer {{DECLINE_OFFER_BUTTON}} to move on to the next one. You will only get the reward if you accept the offer and successfully keep the red bar in the blue target area. So, each offer the question to you is:

Is it worth it for me to put in this much effort for this reward?

Note: not always when accept the offer you will actually have to perform the task, sometimes you will immediately see "Trial Successful" flash up on the screen, in this case you will receive the reward for free.
